title: fix: preserve model descriptions when the separator does not follow the…
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: Fixed model catalog descriptions being truncated when ` - ` separates capabilities rather than following the model title. Community models with independently supplied titles and descriptions now retain text such as “Multilingual translation - preserves formatting and tone”; descriptions that begin with the matching title still have that title removed.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears tiny reading glasses and checks a community model card whose full description spans both sides of a little dash, beside a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized within the scene, with chunky retro sprites, soft pastel gradients, dark purple (#110518) outlines and warm lighting — cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
